cases.title: Global Forms use the selected Location and reject foreign owners
preconditions: Two distinct Locations and a Session-owned Form
stimulus: Create, list, read and settle global Forms with selected Location headers
Reply through the wrong Location and a foreign Session owner

oracles.expected: Correct reply is answered and cancel is cancelled
Rejected attempts leave the intended Form pending

negative: Configured default does not override explicit Location
determinism: Await typed results and canonical state reads
cleanup: Close client and dispose isolated runtime roots
platforms: macOS native Rust and binary v5

cases.title: Full and Mini render pending Forms and remove settled Forms after reconnect
preconditions: Real FormPrompt or Mini runtime with RunFormBody
Client default Location differs from Form Location
stimulus: Reconnect while another Form is pending

oracles.expected: Form title appears while pending and is absent after settlement
Real Rust Form state agrees with the frame

negative: Reconnect does not duplicate the Form
cleanup: Close Mini queue, renderer, client and runtime

cases.title: Unknown settlement never replays or clears a newer answer draft
preconditions: Sent mutation result held behind a Promise gate
Newer Form has an edited draft
stimulus: Settle the old response after editing a newer Form

oracles.expected: Exactly one request per intentional mutation

negative: No stale response clears or replaces a newer draft
cleanup: Release held response and destroy renderer and transport
